corridor_notes: P6230 = the 'Southern Xinjiang' (南疆) half of the same 2023-07-08 14-project announcement as P6229 (9 southern projects / 2113.5 km / 7.99 billion RMB). GEM's Wiki links this row to 'Tarim Basin Rim Gas Pipeline Network' (塔里木盆地周边天然气管网). IMPORTANT: this program's southern projects appear to have been substantially re-branded/consolidated by 2024 under the name '气化南疆天然气管道工程' (Gasification of Southern Xinjiang), which GEM tracks as a SEPARATE row, P7448 (2108 km, construction, started 2024-03-29) — see duplicate/overlap note in researcher_notes. The branches sourced here are: (1) the 气化南疆 west trunk (Kuqa-Bachu, identical corridor to P7448's west branch — kept here too since it is explicitly the shared backbone P6230's 'Aksu' project component connects to), (2) a Kashgar-prefecture local utility branch reaching Tumushuke City/48th Regiment off the Bachu tie-in point (could not source a verifiable URL for this specific segment — see blockers), and (3) a newly-started (Dec 2025) Hotan-prefecture branch reaching the existing CNPC Hotan gas station via Yecheng/Pishan/Kunyu/Moyu — this is presumably one of the 9 original 'southern projects' still being built out as of this research date (2026-07-30). Other likely southern projects (Kizilsu/克州, additional Bazhou/巴州 segments) were not individually named/sourced.
researcher_notes: STRONG SUSPECTED OVERLAP WITH P7448 — flagging for human adjudication rather than setting duplicate_of unilaterally: P6230 ('9 branches', 2113.5 km, proposed, sourced only to the 2023-07 announcement, no RouteType/route) and P7448 ('气化南疆', 2108 km, construction since 2024-03, much more richly documented — capacity, fuel source, an explicit note about the corridor becoming an 'O-shaped' ring) both (a) are explicitly described in official sources as components of the SAME parent program (南北疆天然气利民管道扩建工程), (b) cover the same southern-Xinjiang / Tarim-basin-rim geography (Kashgar/Aksu/Bazhou/Hotan), and (c) have near-identical total lengths (2113.5 vs 2108 km). It looks very likely that the 2023-announced '9 southern projects' were consolidated/rebranded into the 气化南疆 program by the time construction started in 2024, i.e. P6230 may be an earlier, less-developed snapshot of what P7448 now represents in more detail — but I could not find a document that explicitly equates the two, and a Kashgar-prefecture and Hotan-prefecture branch (found here) are not mentioned in any of the 气化南疆-specific sourcing for P7448, so P6230's scope may be somewhat broader than P7448's. Recommend a human decide whether to retire/merge P6230 into P7448 or keep both with a cross-reference note.
blockers: Could not source a verifiable URL for the Kashgar-prefecture branch's exact endpoints (巴楚县段/四十八团段, 149.928 km per a toutiao/tender-aggregator report) — toutiao, jianyu360, dlztb, and bidcenter pages all returned 200 but rendered no extractable body text to the verifier (likely JS-rendered/bot-gated tender portals); kept the claim with empty refs per instructions. Did not find individually-named/sourced branches for the remaining ~5-6 of the original '9 southern projects' (e.g. Kizilsu/克州) within the research budget. See researcher_notes for the P6230/P7448 overlap question, which a human should resolve before drawing final route geometry for either row (drawing both independently risks double-digitizing the same physical pipe).
